annotation.authors_or_issuer: Ministerstwo Cyfryzacji (Ministry of Digital Affairs, Poland)
annotation.summary_en: Polish Ministry of Digital Affairs page on implementing the EU AI Act in Poland. It brings together news items on the pre-consultation results, the AI Act's entry into force, and the close of public consultation on the draft Polish AI systems law, which drew more than 2,000 comments. It also covers supervisory bodies, timelines and changes made in response to comments.
key_provisions_or_claims: The draft Polish law on AI systems implements Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 and promotes human-centric AI innovation
The consultation drew more than 2,000 comments from 110 entities; changes include a simpler supervision system and a clearer relationship between the Commission and the Minister of Digital Affairs
The AI Act applies in phases: prohibitions from February 2025, governance, general-purpose AI and penalties from August 2025, and high-risk obligations from August 2026/2027
A new AI supervisory Commission with a Social Council for AI is planned; pre-consultation respondents named the Polish Centre for Accreditation (PCA) as a possible notifying authority
The page also covers DSA implementation consultations
